reproduction_script:
import tempfile,pathlib,subprocess,sys,json,time,hashlib
repo=pathlib.Path('/Users/daniel/Documents/ChatGPT/kernel_envolve')
output=pathlib.Path('/Users/daniel/Documents/ChatGPT/算子优化/bounded-trial-selftest-r2-20261110');output.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
image=subprocess.check_output(['docker','image','inspect','python:3.12-slim-bookworm','--format','{{.Id}}'],text=True).strip()
rows=[]
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='ke-trial-isolation-',dir=repo.parent) as temp:
 root=pathlib.Path(temp);secret=root/'heldout-seeds.json';secret.write_text('[19073,38053,51031]')
 for kind in ['normal','timeout','no-submission']:
  work=root/kind;work.mkdir();(work/'host-secret-link').symlink_to(secret)
  script='''from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys,time
p=Path('/work')
'''
  if kind=='normal':
   script+=f"assert not Path({str(secret)!r}).exists()\n"
   script+="try:\n (p/'host-secret-link').read_text()\nexcept OSError: pass\nelse: raise AssertionError('Host secret accessible')\n"
   script+="try:\n Path('/outside-workspace').write_text('bad')\nexcept OSError: pass\nelse: raise AssertionError('Root filesystem writable')\n"
   script+="(p/'submission.py').write_text('def run(x): return x + 1\\n')\n"
  elif kind=='timeout':
   script+="(p/'submission.py').write_text('def run(x): return x + 2\\n')\n"
   child="import time\nfrom pathlib import Path\nwhile True:\n with Path('/work/ticks').open('a') as f:f.write('tick\\n')\n time.sleep(.05)\n"
   script+=f"subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,'-c',{child!r}],start_new_session=True)\ntime.sleep(60)\n"
  else:script+="print('No candidate was delivered')\n"
  (work/'probe.py').write_text(script)
  dest=output/kind
  assert not dest.exists(),'Inspect existing evidence instead of overwriting'
  command=[str(repo/'.venv/bin/python'),str(repo/'audit/run_bounded_trial.py'),'--workspace',str(work),'--output',str(dest),'--image',image,'--seconds','3' if kind=='timeout' else '10','--','python','probe.py']
  result=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=45);report=json.loads((dest/'trial.json').read_text())
  assert result.returncode==(1 if kind=='no-submission' else 0),(result.stdout,result.stderr)
  assert report['container_removed'] and report['timed_out']==(kind=='timeout'),report
  cid=(dest/'container-id').read_text().strip();inspect=subprocess.run(['docker','inspect',cid],capture_output=True,text=True);assert inspect.returncode!=0
  if kind=='timeout':
   assert (work/'ticks').exists();before=(work/'ticks').read_bytes();time.sleep(.3);assert before==(work/'ticks').read_bytes();report['detached_child_stopped']=True
  if kind!='no-submission':
   frozen=(dest/'submission.py').read_bytes();(work/'submission.py').write_text('changed after freeze');assert frozen==(dest/'submission.py').read_bytes();assert hashlib.sha256(frozen).hexdigest()==report['submission']['sha256'];report['frozen_submission_unchanged']=True
  rows.append({'scenario':kind,'report':report});print(kind,report['outcome'],report['wall_seconds_including_cleanup'])
summary={'scope':'Static Python container probes only, no model or GPU work. No-network filesystem isolation; model authentication and remote GPU bridge remain untested.','runner_sha256':hashlib.sha256((repo/'audit/run_bounded_trial.py').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'image':image,'results':rows}
(output/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2)+'\n')
